page.overview:
What is Skirmish on Biitu?

A skirmish on Biitu occurred between forces of the Galactic Empire and the companions of the merchant Mungo Baobab. The Empire invaded Biitu to set up a fuel-ore processing plant, and in the process imprisoned Baobab. He was rescued by the droids R2-D2 and C-3PO, and the Biituian Fidge Tadrazan, and together they defeated the Imperials.
